description: The url validator accepts any mysql+<driver> suffix, but build_sql_runner and probe_database branch on scheme.startswith("mysql") and always connect with PyMySQL, discarding the +driver part with no warning or log.

verify_base_tables populates `called` only for dialect == "mysql", so under another non-sqlite dialect a statement with no relation reference returns without any relation/routine verification and without a log.
The removed PostgreSQL connect-timeout paragraph took the blank line before the `## Section: [llm]` heading with it, so a paragraph line now abuts the heading.
The refuse_whole_row_selects catalog definition lost its cross-engine qualification, so a SQLite reader could infer MySQL's mysql/sys/performance_schema names count on SQLite.
The new URL-scheme invariant lives in a validator over a bare str; three consumers re-derive the scheme with wider startswith rules and the validator does not normalize case.
Parallel per-dialect map families in relations.py and system_prompt/default.py agree only by hand, with no import-time consistency check.
_SQLGLOT_DIALECT_MAP keeps mssql and mariadb entries that no loadable config can now produce.
The verify_base_tables docstring hedges with "for example" where the code unconditionally refuses every relation reference under an entry-less dialect, understating a fail-closed guarantee.
The module docstring's reflow after deleting the PostgreSQL clauses leaves ragged mid-sentence lines well under the 100-column limit.
Line 51 runs directly into the `## Section: [llm]` heading because the deleted PostgreSQL paragraph removed the separating blank line.
